item.title: Chapter 1: The Language of Life, The Language of Code
item.description: Chapter 1: The Language of Life, The Language of Code 1.1 A Virus Changed Everything In January 2020, a novel coronavirus appeared in Wuhan, China. Within weeks, it had spread to every continent. Within months, the world shut down. But something else happened just as fast, and it didn’t make the nightly news. On January 11, 2020, Chinese researchers published the genetic sequence of SARS-CoV-2 – the virus that causes COVID-19.
